channel.title: Tool Site HOT
channel.description: Tool Site HOT lists only tool websites you can use right away — converters, formatters, image tools, code tools and more. It discovers the newest tool sites every day from Product Hunt, Hacker News and other tool sources, scores them by rules, and shows only the title, a one-line summary and a link to the original — no articles, no news, no full text republished.

item.title: ToleHub
item.description: Invoices, ROI math, and data format conversions all run online — no install, just open and use.

item.title: KinlorAI
item.description: Make AI images and videos in your browser with templates and free media tools, no app-switching needed.

item.title: Learn Arduino: Interactive 3D Arduino Uno Simulator
item.description: Tinker with a virtual Arduino Uno in your browser — rotate the board, tweak components and watch LEDs blink across 16 interactive lessons, the first three free.

item.title: MonsterX Ai: Free AI Tools for Coding, Writing and Productivity
item.description: A free AI platform with tools for coding assistance, Python error fixing, code explanations, regex generation and more, with selected tools free and no sign-up.

item.title: Free Image to Video
item.description: Turn any photo into a short video with its own sound, free in the browser with no sign-up and no watermark.

item.title: Show HN: Fly through your LinkedIn network in a 3D galaxy
item.description: Turn your LinkedIn network into a 3D galaxy you can fly through, with clusters and connections laid out in front of you.

item.title: Veida AI
item.description: A free, unlimited AI image generator and photo editor that works right in the browser.

item.title: miniDesk
item.description: A free AI helpdesk for small teams: live chat, email, WhatsApp, Instagram and more land in one shared inbox, with an AI agent answering from your own docs and handing off to your team when unsure.

item.title: VisionFlick: Turn Your Goals Into a Manifestation Film
item.description: Type in your goals and get a personal visualization film — AI scenes, video clips, and spoken affirmations, pay once and keep it.

item.title: Prompt Studio – Free, client-side structured prompt generator for LLMs
item.description: Turn a rough idea into a clear, structured prompt you can use with any AI tool, built and edited right in your browser with no API key needed.

item.title: Tapirupscale
item.description: Upload a blurry old video and AI upscales it to crisp 4K right in your browser — no software to install.

item.title: Tyndall AI
item.description: Upload one or two photos, pick a trending meme or dance template, and AI turns them into a short video clip of ten to thirty seconds.

item.title: MagicRemover: Free AI Object Remover for Photos
item.description: Brush over anything in a photo — people, text, or watermarks — and it disappears in seconds, free with no signup and no watermark.

item.title: Tempboxy
item.description: A disposable inbox that opens instantly and pulls verification codes out automatically — handy when you don't want to share your real email.

item.title: RandTools
item.description: Random pickers for League of Legends, Pokémon, Dead by Daylight and more — settle your hero or loadout by luck before the match starts.

item.title: FollowerFuel Free Tools
item.description: 24 social media utilities in one place with no signup — quick help for formatting, counts, and everyday creator chores.

item.title: Show HN: PromptShield – Local reversible secret/PII redactor for LLM prompts
item.description: Swap emails, API keys and other sensitive bits in your prompts for placeholders before sending them to an AI, then restore them in the reply — everything runs locally in your browser.

item.title: Show HN: Browser-only STEP, STL, 3MF and OBJ tools for 3D printing
item.description: View and convert STEP, STL, 3MF and OBJ files for 3D printing right in your browser, plus a snap-fit joint generator and print cost calculator — your files never leave your device.

item.title: Floxolab Sitemap Checker: Free XML Sitemap Checker
item.description: A free checker that scans your XML sitemap and flags indexing issues — paste a URL and get the report.

item.title: AI Ranking Pro
item.description: Track the questions your buyers ask AI every day: open a dated answer, see which pages it cites, and compare the evidence after you change your site.
